In this video we cover:
India’s Credit Card Growth Is Slowing
India’s credit card industry is entering a slower phase after years of rapid growth. While overall spending is still increasing, customer spending per card has weakened and banks are becoming more cautious with lending. The video explains how major players like HDFC Bank, SBI Cards and Payment Services, and ICICI Bank are adjusting their strategies, while smaller issuers such as RBL Bank and AU Small Finance Bank are facing pressure from rising bad loans and weaker profitability.
